metadata.description: Fresh post-Q6 external blind compatibility benchmark for KOMPOSOS with broader source diversity across battery, polymer, metal, ceramic, semiconductor, and glass pair families. Pair identities are separate from audit/blind_test_pairs.json, audit/ground_truth/*.json, prior audit/external_blind/*.json files, and audit/dev_compatibility/*.json.
metadata.selection_policy: Thirty-five source-backed pairs selected from external papers, reviews, handbooks, and public technical references. Labels are evidence-backed compatibility outcomes, not outputs from KOMPOSOS. This file must not be used for bridge tuning; misses should define a separate development set before any successor blind benchmark is reported.
metadata.holdout_policy: Freeze with SHA256 before first diagnostic run. Do not change scorer logic against this file. If results are inspected and used for development, treat this benchmark as spent for future blind claims and freeze a new benchmark.

schema.expected_compatible: true means the pair is reported as usable, stable, standard, or chemically acceptable under the cited context; false means reported incompatibility, decomposition, galvanic failure, immiscibility, or unsuitable direct interface.

episodes.resolution_notes: false_negative:battery_metal_role_context: Aluminum foil is the standard positive-electrode current collector for layered oxide lithium-ion cathodes in passivating LiPF6 electrolyte systems.
false_positive:semiconductor: AlAs on Ge is a difficult heterovalent and mismatched semiconductor pairing rather than a default directly compatible epitaxial interface.
false_negative:semiconductor_family_rule_gap: Si/Ge heteroepitaxy and SiGe technology are canonical semiconductor integration families under strain-managed growth conditions.

details.evidence_basis: Aluminum foil is the standard positive-electrode current collector for layered oxide lithium-ion cathodes in passivating LiPF6 electrolyte systems.
